author: Rawand0
quote: I come home from work to escape reality not to do more of it. GTA 6 makes me fill up my gas tank, pay for repairs and keep up with daily chores. That is not grand theft auto, it's a second job. The pacing is extremely slow. The opening hours drag, and there's too much downtime between missions. For a game this hyped, there's also less freedom than I expected. I wanted to plan a bank job and go loud, and the game keeps steering me back into its systems instead of letting me cause chaos. The graphics aren't a generational leap. Plenty of other games look better, and the 30fps cap with no performance mode is a dealbreaker in 2026. It costs this game several points on its **** bugs hurt too. In my experience the launch is rough, closer to Cyberpunk 2077 than to Rockstar's usual polish. The physics are also inconsistent. The game sells itself on realism, yet heads come off far too easily and a car running over one decapitates it instead of doing what you'd expect.
